_label: TEACHING rules - a handful of values quoted in the owner's digests/card, NOT a CLSI/EUCAST table. Breakpoints and QC ranges change by edition: replace with your lab's current CLSI M100 / EUCAST values.

breakpoints._src: 509402 digest §3.3 MRSA: cefoxitin 30 ug, S. aureus zone <=21 R, >=22 S, report as oxacillin
clinmicro card FORK 4: CoNS zone <=24 mm = R. S >=25 assumed (no I category stated) - verify against your edition
509402 digest §3.3: oxacillin MIC S. aureus R >=4, S <=2 ug/mL

criteria._src: 509402 digest §3.3 ESBL combination disk: zone with clavulanate >= 5 mm larger -> ESBL+

_ampc_src: clinmicro card trap 10b (IDSA 2023 core three). Hafnia/Serratia/Morganella/Providencia deliberately NOT listed (card: low-risk, treat per AST).

intrinsic_resistance._src: 509402 digest §3.4 (no AMP / low-generation cephalosporin on the P. aeruginosa panel); card trap 10. Add low-generation cephalosporins from your table.
